title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10139)
clause_1_scope: 1,1 This standard defines the items which should be considered for the presentation of information regarding predictions of quantitative IS : 10139 - 1982 characteristics of reliability, maintainability and availability of systems and equipment including hardware, software and human elements.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Piezoelectric Ceramic Elements (Impact Type and Squeeze Type) For Gas Lighters
Mathematical guide to the terms and definitions for reliability of electronic equipment and components (or parts) used therein

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
